state_machine.description: Each invocation processes the batch independently; no state is retained between scans.

priorities: Never write analogValues or channel configuration fields.
Process only ordinal positions 0 through count-1, using each array's independent lower bound.
Disabled and out-of-count channels retain both output fields exactly.
For enabled channels, an invalid measuringMode takes priority over invalid limits.
Validate hiLIM > loLIM for every supported mode. Errors update retVal only; outputValue is preserved.
Successful conversions set retVal to 16#0000. Do not clamp extrapolated values.

initial_values.channel_output_fields: Caller-provided values; do not initialize or clear them on FB creation or scan entry.
initial_values.temporary_variables: Assign before use on each invocation; no prior value is relied upon.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
actions: No edge detectors are required. Sample count and both array bounds; use the caller's sampled array contents for this invocation.
The caller must keep the referenced data stable during the invocation, or the implementation must use an equivalent entry snapshot.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: No reset input or state transition is required.
Check count against zero and both array lengths before indexing, using sufficiently wide bounds arithmetic. The caller guarantees a valid count; defensively perform no writes if it is invalid.
Resolve channel decisions in this order: enabled, supported mode, valid limits, conversion.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: No timers are required; there are no timer FB calls.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
actions: If count is zero, make no element writes. Otherwise iterate ordinal j from 0 to count-1; pair analogValues[LOWER_BOUND(analogValues,1)+j] with channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels,1)+j].
For a disabled channel, write neither retVal nor outputValue. For an unsupported mode, write retVal=16#8001 only. Otherwise, if hiLIM<=loLIM, write retVal=16#8002 only.
For a valid channel, calculate using widened floating-point intermediates, then assign outputValue as REAL and retVal=16#0000. Promote raw before arithmetic to avoid INT overflow.
Mode 0 unipolar: loLIM + (raw/27648.0)*(hiLIM-loLIM). Mode 0 bipolar: loLIM + ((raw+27648.0)/55296.0)*(hiLIM-loLIM).
Mode 1: raw/10.0. Mode 2: raw/100.0. Do not modify any channel outside the processed range.
